# Unconditional per-R nonexistence certificates for [4,16]/[2,4,16] on M_1(8,4)
# (Claude prod session 2026-07-18, target #3; see notes/claude_prod_03_416.md)
#
# For each listed R = a/b (and automatically its involution mirror 1/R via
# (R,w) -> (1/R,1/w)), BOTH genus-1 membership quartics
#   C_R^+ : y^2 = -(a+b)(b^2 w^2-a^2)(w+1)((a+3b)w-(3a+b))
#   C_R^- : y^2 =  (a+b)(w-1)((a+3b)w+(3a+b))(b^2(a^2+2ab-b^2)w^2+a^2(a^2-2ab-b^2))
# have 2-descent rank upper bound 0 (PARI ellrank r2 = 0, unconditional:
# Selmer - torsion - Cassels pairing), so all rational w on the fiber are
# images of torsion points of the two elliptic models.  Every such torsion
# image w (listed; in the event all 628 non-boundary images were non-degenerate)
# is killed by an audited all-twist kill residue (w:killP, sound: good
# reduction at P + residue proven incompatible with exponent-16 torsion for
# every twist; prime histogram 11:217 13:171 17:151 19:38 23:38 29:9 31:2 37:2).
# Hence NO rational w gives a [4,16] or [2,4,16] Jacobian over these fibers.
# Format: a b  w:status ...
